issues.description: Script uses GM_xmlhttpRequest to send data to discord.com, likely for sharing map pins or game data. This constitutes data exfiltration to a third-party server.
issues.location: GM_xmlhttpRequest calls (not fully shown, but @connect discord.com and description indicate usage)
issues.recommendation: Limit data sent to Discord, ensure no sensitive user information or authentication tokens are transmitted.

issues.description: Script uses GM_xmlhttpRequest to access nominatim.openstreetmap.org, likely for geocoding. While this is a public API, user location data may be transmitted.
issues.location: GM_xmlhttpRequest calls (not fully shown, but @connect nominatim.openstreetmap.org and description indicate usage)
issues.recommendation: Ensure only necessary location data is sent, avoid transmitting user identifiers.

issues.description: Script listens to keyboard events (Tab, Q, G, X, V, T) for feature toggles, but does not appear to log or transmit keystrokes.
issues.recommendation: Ensure no keylogger behavior is introduced; do not transmit input data.

issues.description: Script accesses localStorage and sessionStorage, but only for feature toggles and state. No sensitive data collection detected.
issues.recommendation: Do not store or transmit sensitive user data.

issues.description: Script uses Notification API to display notifications to the user.
issues.recommendation: Do not abuse Notification API for spam or phishing.

issues.description: Script uses WebSocket interception to read game data and opponent guesses, but does not transmit this data externally.
issues.recommendation: Ensure intercepted data is not sent to third parties.

issues.description: Script modifies iframe sandbox attributes and frame protection, potentially weakening clickjacking protections.
issues.recommendation: Avoid weakening frame protections unless necessary.

issues.description: Script disables cheat detection scripts and modifies Array.prototype.push, which may interfere with site integrity.
issues.recommendation: Avoid interfering with site security mechanisms.

issues.description: Script requires msgpack.js from greasyfork update CDN, which is a trusted source but not version-hashed.
issues.recommendation: Pin third-party dependencies to a specific version hash.

script_name: CheatGuessr Universal | GeoGuessr | OpenGuessr | WorldGuessr | FreeGuessr | GeoDuels | Geotastic
summary: 该脚本存在严重的数据外传风险，主要通过 GM_xmlhttpRequest 向 discord.com 和 nominatim.openstreetmap.org 发送用户游戏数据和位置信息。虽然未检测到代码混淆和 DOM XSS，但存在隐私采集（如 WebSocket 拦截、存储操作）、敏感 API 调用（通知）、iframe 保护弱化，以及供应链风险（未哈希固定的第三方依赖）。建议严格限制外传数据、加强依赖管理，并避免干扰站点安全机制。
